headline: Sugar House Hotel grand opening, which a quorum of councilors may attend.
summary: This notice is posted under Vermont's Open Meeting Law because a quorum may attend. It lists no council business to act on.
items: Sugar House Hotel grand opening event, which a quorum of councilors may attend
plain_text:
Notice of Quorum - Winooski City Council
l A quorum of Winooski City Councilors may attend the Sugar House Hotel grand opening 
event on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 4:30 PM 
l No official City Council actions will occur; this notice meets the Vermont Open Meeting Law 
requirement
